extra.text: Not every household owns steel. Craft two firesticks for the old friction-fire lesson.
Your first verified completion counts as Lamplighters civic service. Joining the guild is optional.

accept.text: Choose dry wood and patient hands. A firestick is humble, not effortless.

decline.text: Very well. There are many ways to keep a neighbor warm.

in_progress.text: Two finished firesticks let each pair practice without waiting on the other.

ready.text: Simple tools, honestly made. Lay them beside the practice hearth.

extra.text: Tonight nobody goes home unable to make a flame.
The Lamplighters will remember your service. Ask a guild contact about introductions and workshop commissions.
